notes: types: the 22 type words as the site and the API spell them, lowercase and singular.
refusals: every reason a reader or a writer refuses by, in the order a parser checks them (no_world and bad_form are the writer's only).

format cases: address gives form (human or text), world (absent for the in-world text form), type and id (both absent for a world's own address), and optionally lens and moment; expect is the exact string a writer writes, or refuse the reason.

parse cases: text is the string as a reader receives it; expect is the reading (form, world, world_is_slug, type, id, lens, moment, canonical; type and id null for a world's own address), or refuse the reason. canonical is true when the string as received is exactly what a writer writes for that reading.
ids: any UUID version, in the hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 form; read in either case of hex, always written lowercase.
